rulings: CF-A-SET-NAME-IS-NEVER-A-PARALLEL (Drew, 2026-09-07): a parallel comes only from the finish vocabulary (#1935/#1938) or a checklist-attested parallel - NEVER from set-name residue. `twilight` is half of Twilight Masquerade; `rocket` is half of Team Rocket; neither is a card line.

CF-EVERY-INGEST-USES-THE-ONE-CHECKLIST-FORMAT: blank means unknown, never a guess. The destination is the base address because these rows state no parallel at all, not because base was measured to be right.
CF-ONE-CARD-ONE-ROW-ONE-POOL: each fake parallel is a SPLIT of its set's base pool - 58 Crystal Guardians rows priced apart from the base cards they are.

A FINISH IS A DIFFERENT CARD LINE (#1935). 25 of these 220 titles state a real finish in words. This list does NOT route them there: it removes the residue only, and the finish is a separate ruled decision.

CF-THE-PARTITION-IS-WHERE-THE-ROW-IS. The mis-filed list set `from` to the row's hobbyiqCardId while sold_comps is partitioned on /cardId. All 220 point-reads at that address returned 404 — which is precisely the `not found at fromCardId` the failed runs reported. Every fromCardId here was VERIFIED BY POINT-READ on 2026-09-07: 220 of 220 live at their partitionKey, 0 at the old `from`.

TWO POPULATIONS, COUNTED BY SOURCE, NOT BY ROW COUNT. 196 rows are `cardhedge` whose cardId is a Bubble product id (e.g. 1744084037529x204477132428318800) and 24 are `tca-ebay` whose cardId is an `hiq:baseball:` slug. They are not the same defect and they do not take the same action.

196 REPOINT — VENDOR-DESIGN is not damage (#1650, split-identity.cjs). A vendor ingest partitions under the VENDOR's product id and carries our slug beside it; the fields disagree BY CONSTRUCTION, and decideSplitIdentity fails open on them (12.96M rows). The cardId names no sport at all, so the rule `never repoint by hobbyiqCardId alone when the cardId is wrong-sport` is not engaged: there is no rival sport to arbitrate. The row is already in its right partition, only hobbyiqCardId carries the set-name residue, so ONE field changes and the lane patches it in place.

24 PARK — genuine split identity, and the destination does not exist. These carry cardId sport=baseball against hobbyiqCardId sport=pokemon (the live `baseball` DEFAULT the #1929 emitter fix closed). A REPOINT of hobbyiqCardId alone is FORBIDDEN here because the cardId is wrong-sport; a RELOCATE is refused for a second, independent reason — all 7 of their base destinations have ZERO card_catalog rows, so a relocate would MINT a card from sales (#1924: 0 of 1,218 destinations existed → the vehicle is PARK). All 24 already read identityUnverified=true; the lane is only-improve, so they re-read as `already at the target` and this list asserts their classification without re-stamping it.
